description: one Address + one u64 + one bool: 8 discriminator + 32 + 8 + 1
two Addresses + three u64 + no bool: 8 + 64 + 24
empty struct still carries the 8-byte discriminator

no struct has this many fields, and that is the point: it is a garbage count, the kind the caller hands you when something upstream is wrong. The guard has to refuse it with 0. Add the discriminator outside the chain (`...unwrap_or(0) + 8`) and the answer is 8 instead — a refusal dressed up as an empty account
